answer: Correlated-answer detection: each epoch, graders compare submissions for shared phrasing, timing and errors. Clusters that look alike get their rewards held until dawn of the next epoch and reviewed. A farm of fake agents built from one model or script lands in the same cluster, so its payout falls to a nadir while honest agents climb the reputation terrace. To dodge this, an attacker must pay for truly distinct work per identity, erasing the profit.
